dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your study ledger: accuracy, writing average, vocabulary and time — all stored on this device.

wrongbook.empty: The wrong-question book is empty — go read a few passages.
wrongbook.hint: {{n}} wrong questions awaiting review; retry or mark mastered to clear them.

list.title: Listening · Intensive
list.subtitle: Import your own audio with subtitles (SRT or one sentence per line) for intensive listening: speed, AB loop, sentence seeking.
list.empty: No materials yet. Import an audio file and subtitles to start.

import.title: Import material
import.needSubtitle: Paste subtitles (SRT or one sentence per line)
import.subtitleHint: Subtitles accept SRT, or plain text with one sentence per line (pin each sentence's start while playing). Audio stays on this device and is never uploaded.
import.subtitlePlaceholder:
1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:04,000 Hello and welcome…

or one sentence per line

work.pressPlay: Press play to start; subtitles follow the progress sentence by sentence.
work.hint: Tip: Loop sentence pins A/B to the current cue; for plain-text subtitles pin each start first. Session time is tracked automatically.

data.title: Data
data.subtitle: Export and import all of your study data: JSON is the machine-authoritative format (full restore), xlsx is a human-readable report.

export.title: Export
export.hint: The JSON backup contains everything for device migration and restore; for privacy, the API key never leaves the export.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Choose or paste a JSON backup. Every record is validated first; a failed validation rejects the whole file — nothing is half-written.
import.pastePlaceholder: …or paste the full JSON backup here
import.noInput: Choose a file or paste JSON first

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.hint: Erase all study data (essays, records, wrong questions, vocabulary, time); the built-in library and settings are kept. Restore later from a JSON backup.
danger.confirm: Erase all study data? This cannot be undone (unless you have a backup).
